steps.description: Push 1 (frequency 3) onto the heap - it now holds 1 candidate.
Push 2 (frequency 2) onto the heap - it now holds 2 candidates.
Push 3 (frequency 1) onto the heap - it now holds 3 candidates.
More than 2 candidates - drop 3 (least frequent, at 1), keeping only the top 2 so far.
Heap holds exactly the 2 most frequent values: [1, 2].
